title: The MongoDB Data Model
subtitle: BSON types, ObjectIds, and document structure

content.text: MongoDB stores documents as BSON, an extension of JSON that adds types like Date, ObjectId, and binary data.

content.definition: A 12-byte unique identifier automatically generated for the _id field of each document.

content.text: Always let MongoDB generate _id unless you have a natural unique key.

questions.question: What BSON type is used for the _id field by default?
questions.explanation: MongoDB uses ObjectId as the default _id type.

faq.a: Yes. Set _id to any unique value you want, like a user email or slug. Just ensure uniqueness across the collection.

examples: Using email as _id for user collections
